title: The Velocity Trap — Technical Debt Accumulation
context: Engineering leadership proposes shipping features at 2x velocity by deferring code reviews, skipping tests, and accepting known architectural shortcuts. Product claims this increases market capture by 40%.

Agent_Alpha_Linear.claim: Doubling feature velocity increases market share by 40% if competitors remain at current pace

Agent_Beta_HSP.counter_claim: Deferred quality causes exponential incident growth that erodes velocity gains if technical debt exceeds 50% threshold

resolution_criteria.success_metric: Net feature velocity after 12 months (accounting for incident handling time)
